name: Schottky diodes
summary: Fast diodes with a low voltage drop, used in solar, switching supplies and polarity protection.
uses: Solar blocking diodes that waste less power
Repairing switching power supplies and DC-DC converters
Combining two power sources so either can feed a load
identify: Like rectifier diodes but marked SS14, SS34, 1N5819, 1N5822 or SR560; dual ones in TO-220 cases on PC power supplies, and bypass diodes in solar panel junction boxes.
test: On diode mode: about 0.15–0.45V forward and open in reverse. A little reverse leakage is normal for Schottkys.
